about_short_description.short_description: MantleBio is an operator of a medical technology company intended to build software to scale data-driven discovery for biotech.

product.name: Mantle Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that integrates biotech data, computation, and team collaboration to streamline data-driven discovery processes.

product.name: Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN)
product.description: A digital notebook for running, recording, and sharing reproducible bioinformatics analyses with automatic data lineage tracking.

product.name: Bioinformatics Pipeline Hosting
product.description: Infrastructure hosting for bioinformatics pipelines, allowing users to run custom or pre-built workflows at scale.

product.name: Data Integration and ETL Automation
product.description: Software tools that automate extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of biotech data from various sources to reduce errors and centralize data management.

identifier.value: Jupyter Notebook Integration with Compute Resources

product.name: Jupyter Notebook Integration with Compute Resources
product.description: Integration of Jupyter notebooks with customizable compute environments and on-demand GPU access for data analysis and machine learning.
